semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company's high-purity stainless steel seamless tubes are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing environments that require contamination-free materials.
summary: Seico Hi-Purity Tubes Pvt. Ltd. manufactures high-purity stainless steel seamless tubes with a focus on high-tech and clean industries, including semiconductor manufacturing. Their products feature a Bright Annealed surface finish for superior corrosion resistance and cleanliness, complying with global standards such as ASME BPE and ASTM A 269/A270.
capabilities: Tight tolerance control in OD, ID, and wall thickness
